My dear Madam
I am very sorry that [Mr Macmillan](/person/939) was so disappointing.

He might as well have looked at the drawings I have been waiting to hear from [Mr Ward](/organisation/236), 67 Chandos St, Covent Garden He will gladly see you, and I sent him the MS of the Bear and the Goblin.[^1] You had better make an appointment with him mentioning my name; and shew him some of your drawings I think it might lead to something as his line is illustration

yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: \'The Bear and the Goblin\' was a poem by Francis Dawson. CMY was trying to help this illustrator, who had evidently illustrated it, get commissions from publishers.
